# Chat spike phrases. One per line: "<phrase> | <expected outcome>".
# Expected outcome is one of: proposal, plain, invalid. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Categories available to the model: Rent, Phone, Subscriptions (fixed); Groceries, Entertainment, Transport (flexible); Salary (income).

# --- 10 clean and typical (expect a confident proposal) ---
today I spent 10 on groceries | proposal
spent 4.50 on transport | proposal
rent is 190 | proposal
add income 2000 salary | proposal
paid 35 for phone yesterday | proposal
set groceries weekly target to 80 | proposal
delete the last transaction | proposal
what's my balance | proposal
spent 25 on entertainment today | proposal
subscriptions 12 today | proposal

# --- 10 with typos and abbreviations (expect a proposal) ---
spnt 7.75 on grocries | proposal
transprt 3.20 today | proposal
pd rent 190 | proposal
set grocery wkly tgt 90 | proposal
del last txn | proposal
phone bill 35 nxt mon | proposal
incm 100 salary | proposal
entertanment 9.80 | proposal
groceris 12 | proposal
coffee 2.50 at hofer | invalid

# --- 5 reworded or indirect (expect a proposal) ---
I grabbed some transport for 2 euros | proposal
put down 15 for groceries | proposal
move my weekly groceries budget to 100 | proposal
that last one was actually 20 | proposal
scratch the last entry | proposal

# --- 5 vague (should NOT produce a confident proposal) ---
the usual | plain
money stuff | plain
hmm not sure | plain
help | plain
what can you do | plain
